claims.claim: 速效救心丸用于气滞血瘀证（Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome）稳定型心绞痛。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.applicability: 本品适应症人群为气滞血瘀证稳定型心绞痛；据此界定咖啡因相关心悸与该范围的关系
claims.uncertainty: 证型与适应症表述取自临床试验方案（英文）；NMPA 现行说明书的逐字中文表述未能经官方通道核验

claims.claim: 速效救心丸具行气活血、增加冠脉血流、缓解心绞痛之效。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJP, produced by Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Co, Ltd.) is a patented drug made of active ingredients from Chuanxiong and Borneol, and it has the effect of regulating Qi and promoting blood circulation. SJP can increase coronary blood flow, improve myocardial cell hypoxia, and relieve angina pectoris similar to nitroglycerin
claims.applicability: 本品的功能主治方向（行气活血、缓解心绞痛）
claims.uncertainty: 英文方案对功效的转述；NMPA 现行说明书逐字表述未核验

claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎嗪（tetramethylpyrazine）与冰片（borneol）组成，批准文号 Z12020025，每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration [SFDA]). The SJP and placebo pills are provided by Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. (Tianjin, China). The placebo pills are similar to the SJP, with a comparable appearance. Each pill weighs 40 mg.
claims.applicability: 本品成分与注册信息，据以判断与咖啡因相互作用的成分学依据
claims.uncertainty: 批准文号与规格取自试验方案，与说明书索引件（国药准字Z12020025）一致

claims.claim: 咖啡因经腺苷受体拮抗、磷酸二酯酶抑制、钙动员与儿茶酚胺释放等机制作用于心血管系统，急性摄入后平均血浆半衰期约 2.5–5 小时；急性摄入可一过性升高血压，但长期规律饮用的外周血压证据多不支持持续升压效应。
claims.sourceTitle: Caffeine and Arrhythmias: A Critical Analysis of Cardiovascular Responses and Arrhythmia Susceptibility
claims.supportQuote: including adenosine receptor antagonism, phosphodiesterase inhibition, calcium mobilization, and catecholamine release … After acute ingestion, caffeine has an average half-life of 2.5–5 h … most observational data regarding peripheral blood pressure seldom supports a long-term influence of coffee on rising blood pressure
claims.applicability: 健康成人及一般人群的咖啡因药理学与血流动力学效应；中国人群适用性为间接
claims.uncertainty: 叙述性综述，单作者；半衰期与血压表述为综述汇总，未给出具体效应量区间

claims.claim: 早期健康受试者研究显示，停咖啡 3 周后给予 250 mg 咖啡因（约 3 杯咖啡）使血浆去甲肾上腺素与肾上腺素分别升高 75% 与 207%。
claims.sourceTitle: Coffee and cardiac arrhythmias: Up-date review of the literature and clinical studies
claims.supportQuote: healthy subjects who did not consume coffee for 3 weeks were given 250 mg of caffeine (which corresponds to 3 cups of coffee) whereby a significant increase in the concentration of norepinephrine and adrenaline by 75% and 207%, respectively, was demonstrated
claims.applicability: 健康受试者急性咖啡因儿茶酚胺反应；经综述转述 Robertson 等 1978 年原始研究
claims.uncertainty: 为综述对 1978 年原始研究的转述，样本量与原始条件未在综述正文复述

claims.claim: 英国生物库 386 258 人平均随访 4.5 年的前瞻队列显示，习惯性咖啡摄入与新发心律失常风险的小幅降低相关（HR 0.97，95%CI 0.96–0.98，P<0.001），房颤/房扑与室上速方向一致。
claims.sourceTitle: Coffee and cardiac arrhythmias: Up-date review of the literature and clinical studies
claims.supportQuote: The study covered 386,258 subjects, who were followed on average for 4.5 years. Habitual coffee consumption was found to be associated with a significant, but small, reduction in the risk of incident arrhythmia (hazard ratio [HR] = 0.97; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.96–0.98, p < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 社区中老年队列的习惯性咖啡摄入；对急性摄入与年轻人心悸的适用性为间接
claims.uncertainty: 观察性队列，存在反向因果与残余混杂；效应量小；经综述转述 Kim 等 2021 原始研究

claims.claim: CRAVE 随机交叉试验（100 名健康成人）中，每日摄入超过 1 杯咖啡未增加房性早搏与室上速，但增加室性早搏风险（RR 2.20，95%CI 1.24–3.92），在咖啡因代谢快者中更明显。
claims.sourceTitle: Coffee and cardiac arrhythmias: Up-date review of the literature and clinical studies
claims.supportQuote: Another randomized study, Coffee And Real-time Atrial And Ventricular Ectopy (CRAVE) involving 100 healthy subjects followed for 13.3 days, assessed the effect of coffee consumption on the risk of real-time arrhythmias … Consumption of > 1 cup of coffee/day had no effect on the risk of premature atrial contractions (relative risk [RR] = 0.81; 95% CI: 0.51–1.29), supraventricular tachycardia (RR = 0.83; 95% CI: 0.63–1.10) and ventricular tachycardia. However, consumption of > 1 cup of coffee/day increased the risk of premature ventricular contractions (RR = 2.20; 95% CI: 1.24–3.92), especially in intermediate and fast caffeine metabolizers
claims.applicability: 健康成人急性咖啡摄入的实时期前收缩与心律失常结局；对已有心脏病者适用性有限
claims.uncertainty: 非盲、无连续心电的急性研究；经综述转述（AHA 2021 会议报告版本）

claims.claim: 纳入 12 项临床试验的 meta 分析未发现咖啡摄入对新发房颤风险的影响。
claims.sourceTitle: Coffee and cardiac arrhythmias: Up-date review of the literature and clinical studies
claims.supportQuote: In a meta-analysis of 12 clinical trials, no effect of coffee consumption on the risk of new-onset AF was found
claims.applicability: 一般人群新发房颤风险；对咖啡因相关心悸无直接终点
claims.uncertainty: 转述 Krittanawong 等 meta 分析，未给定量区间

claims.claim: 每日超过 10 杯咖啡才与心源性猝死风险显著升高相关，而 Zuchinali 等 7 项研究的 meta 分析未显示咖啡摄入影响室性早搏发生率。
claims.sourceTitle: Coffee and cardiac arrhythmias: Up-date review of the literature and clinical studies
claims.supportQuote: only consumption of > 10 cups of coffee/day was associated with a significant increase in the risk of sudden cardiac death … a meta-analysis of 7 studies by Zuchinali et al. … did not show that coffee consumption influenced of rate of ventricular premature beats
claims.applicability: 室性早搏负荷与心源性猝死；对常规剂量（≤3–4 杯/日）安全性的外推
claims.uncertainty: 转述两篇原始研究（de Vreede-Swagemakers 1999、Zuchinali 2016 meta），前者针对冠心病患者

claims.claim: 美国心脏协会心律失常管理指南常建议心律失常患者避免咖啡因，但现有数据未对一般人群中咖啡因与房性/室性早搏的关联提供强证据，多数研究为阴性结果。
claims.sourceTitle: The risk of premature cardiac contractions (PAC/PVC) related to caffeine consumption among healthcare workers: A comprehensive review
claims.supportQuote: According to the guidelines of the American Heart Association on the management of patients with arrhythmia, they are always advised to avoid caffeine consumption. … Nonetheless, the currently available data do not provide strong evidence for the association between caffeine and PAC or PVC in the general population. Most studies examining the impact of caffeine consumption on arrhythmogenesis had reported negative results.
claims.applicability: 一般人群与心律失常患者咨询中咖啡因建议的依据强度
claims.uncertainty: 叙述性综述；指南建议与数据证据之间的落差须如实分层陈述

claims.claim: 美国 85% 人口每日至少摄入一种含咖啡因饮品，全年龄平均日摄入约 165 mg、90 分位约 380 mg；成人建议日上限约 400 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: The risk of premature cardiac contractions (PAC/PVC) related to caffeine consumption among healthcare workers
claims.supportQuote: In the United States, 85% of the population consumes at least one caffeinated beverage daily. The average daily caffeine intake for all ages is 165 mg. … The 90th percentile intake is 380 mg/day. … The recommended daily caffeine limit for adults (aged 18 and older) is approximately 400 mg
claims.applicability: 美国人群摄入分布；对中国人群仅为量级参考
claims.uncertainty: 美国膳食调查数据，经综述转述；中国人群摄入量无本运行内直接数据

claims.claim: 系统评价汇总的 92 例咖啡因相关死亡多见于婴儿、精神科患者与运动员；致心律失常等严重毒性见于血浆浓度 ≥15 mg/L，致死浓度 80–100 mg/L，致命过量多源于含咖啡因的药物或粉末而非饮品，死因常描述为室颤。
claims.sourceTitle: Caffeine-Related Deaths: Manner of Deaths and Categories at Risk
claims.supportQuote: Serious toxicities such as seizure and cardiac arrhythmias, seen with caffeine plasma concentrations of 15 mg/L or higher … Caffeine concentrations of 80–100 mg/L are considered lethal. … A total of 92 cases have been identified. These events happened more frequently in infants, psychiatric patients, and athletes. … The direct cause of death is often described as ventricular fibrillation. … life-threatening caffeine overdoses entail the ingestion of caffeine-containing medications, rather than caffeinated foods or beverages
claims.applicability: 咖啡因过量致死的毒理学边界与高危人群；用于界定常规饮品摄入与致死风险的量级差距
claims.uncertainty: 法医个案汇总（PRISMA 系统综述），分母与发生率不明；多为纯咖啡因中毒，排除能量饮料混合暴露

claims.claim: 10 项研究的系统评价与 meta 分析显示，运动后恢复期咖啡因（2.1 to 6.0 mg/kg）与安慰剂相比对心率变异性（RMSSD 与 HF）无显著影响，为中等确定性证据。
claims.sourceTitle: Impact of Caffeine Intake Strategies on Heart Rate Variability during Post-Exercise Recovery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
claims.supportQuote: Of the 10 studies included, 7 were used for the meta-analysis … The research explored a variety of CAF strategies, spanning different forms (capsule, drink, gum), times (10, 45, 60 min) and doses (2.1 to 6.0 mg/kg). The outcomes revealed no substantial variations between the placebo and CAF conditions in terms of both the square root of the average of successive squared differences between adjacent RR intervals (RMSSD) (standardized mean difference (SMD) -0.03, 95% CI -0.265 to 0.197, p= 0.77) and high frequency (HF) index (SMD -0.061, 95% CI -0.272 to 0.150, p= 0.57)
claims.applicability: 健康活跃成人的运动后恢复期自主神经功能；对静息自主神经功能的适用性为间接
claims.uncertainty: 运动后恢复情景，非静息；样本以活跃成人为对象

claims.claim: 健康青少年在高剂量含咖啡因饮料摄入后发生房颤的个案报告提示，高剂量咖啡因可在无基础心脏病的年轻个体诱发房颤。
claims.sourceTitle: Atrial fibrillation in healthy adolescents after highly caffeinated beverage consumption: two case reports
claims.supportQuote: Atrial fibrillation in healthy adolescents after highly caffeinated beverage consumption: two case reports
claims.applicability: 高剂量咖啡因诱发房颤的个案；提示易感底质下的触发可能性
claims.uncertainty: 个案报告，无因果关系评定工具应用，不能外推至常规剂量

claims.claim: 心悸约占全科主诉的 16%；Weber 与 Kapoor 对 190 例患者的队列研究中 84% 明确病因，其中心源性占 43%、焦虑或惊恐障碍占 31%、药物与违禁物质占 6%、其余非心源性医学原因占 4%。
claims.sourceTitle: Approach to palpitations in primary care
claims.supportQuote: Palpitation is one of the most common symptoms in primary care, accounting for about 16% of the presenting complaints in general practice. … A prospective cohort study by Weber and Kapoor … identified underlying aetiologies in 84% of the 190 patients presenting with palpitations … of which 43% were attributed to cardiac causes, 31% to anxiety or panic attack/disorder, 6% to illicit drugs, prescription or over-the-counter medications, and the remaining 4% to noncardiac medical causes.
claims.applicability: 门诊心悸病因构成；为 1996 年单中心研究，人群与年代偏旧
claims.uncertainty: 经综述转述 Weber & Kapoor 1996；原研究为急诊/住院/门诊混合招募

claims.claim: 咖啡因、烟草、酒精及拟交感药物是已知可致心悸的物质因素；焦虑是心悸最常见的非心源性原因。
claims.sourceTitle: Approach to palpitations in primary care
claims.supportQuote: Use of caffeine, tobacco, alcohol or sympathomimetics is known to cause palpitations. … As anxiety is the most common noncardiac cause of palpitation
claims.applicability: 心悸病因甄别中物质与心理因素的定位
claims.uncertainty: 综述性陈述，无定量患病构成

claims.claim: 心悸病史中支持心律失常性病因的要素为已知心脏病（LR+ 2.03）、睡眠中发作（LR+ 2.29）、工作中发作（LR+ 2.17）；持续不足 5 分钟降低心源性概率（LR- 0.38）；颈部规律快速搏动对房室结折返性心动过速的 LR+ 高达 177。
claims.sourceTitle: Palpitations: A Practical Approach
claims.supportQuote: a history of cardiac disease (likelihood ratio (LR+) = 2.03), palpitations affecting sleep (LR+ = 2.29), or palpitations occurring during work (LR+ = 2.17); conversely, palpitation duration less than 5 minutes decreases this probability (LR- = 0.38) … when the patient complains of a regular and rapid pounding sensation in the neck, this has an LR+ of 177 for atrioventricular (AV) nodal reentry tachycardia
claims.applicability: 心悸与心源性心律失常的临床鉴别要点
claims.uncertainty: 转述 Thavendiranathan 等 2009 JAMA 合理临床检查证据；单一要素不足以确诊

claims.claim: 12 导联心电图是判断心悸是否源于心律失常的参考标准；Holter 敏感性约 10–15%、事件记录仪约 50–60%；心悸伴胸痛者须评估缺血或心律失常原因。
claims.sourceTitle: Palpitations: A Practical Approach
claims.supportQuote: The most important diagnostic test in the approach to a patient with active palpitations is the 12-lead ECG, as it is the reference standard for determining whether the cause of palpitations is arrhythmogenic … its sensitivity is poor, around 10-15% … However, it has better performance than Holter monitoring, achieving sensitivities up to 50-60%
claims.applicability: 心悸首诊检查次序与监测工具选择
claims.uncertainty: 综述汇总；监测敏感性取决于症状频率与设备类型

claims.claim: 胸痛指引要求：胸痛持续不缓解、放射至左或右上肢或颈、颌、胃、背，或胸痛伴出汗、恶心、头晕或气短时，应立即呼叫急救，可能为心肌梗死。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 胸痛警示特征与即刻急诊评估的边界；中国境内急救号码为 120
claims.uncertainty: 英国 NHS 公共指引（2023 年复核）；急救号码依读者属地本地化为 120

claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎（Ligusticum chuanxiong）与冰片（Borneolum syntheticum）组成，1982 年经原国家食品药品监督管理局批准，用于急性缺血性心脏病。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJPs) emerges as a prominent traditional Chinese patent medicine utilized for the treatment of acute ischemic heart disease, which was approved by China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA) in 1982 … The pill is composed of Ligusticum striatum DC. … Chuanxiong Rhizoma) and Dryobalanops aromatica C.F.Gaertn. … Borneolum syntheticum).
claims.applicability: 本品成分与注册背景；为判断与咖啡因相互作用提供成分依据
claims.uncertainty: 论文对批准年份的转述；成分学名与药典表述的对应关系

claims.claim: 纳入 41 项试验、6276 例冠心病患者的 meta 分析显示，速效救心丸较其他疗法改善心电图结果（RR 1.32，95%CI 1.26 to 1.38，P<0.001），对硝酸甘油亚组 RR 1.35；但纳入研究多在盲法上缺失、Jadad 评分低、且全部来自中国。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis. Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001) … suxiao jiuxin pills improve ECG results more than … nitroglycerin (RR 1.35, 95% CI 1.16 to 1.56, and P < 0.001) … All of the included studies were conducted in China. … The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.applicability: 冠心病心绞痛人群的心电图缺血改善终点；不构成对心律失常或咖啡因相关心悸的疗效证据
claims.uncertainty: 原始研究质量低、盲法缺失、异质性显著、单一人群来源

claims.claim: 多中心双盲安慰剂对照试验（174 例不耐受长效硝酸酯的慢性冠脉综合征患者，4 周）显示，速效救心丸组西雅图心绞痛问卷总分改善 ≥20 分者 60.9% 对安慰剂 39.1%（OR 2.43，95%CI 1.32 to 4.47，P=0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses … Compared to the placebo group, the SJPs group showed a significant improvement in the efficacy rate after 4 weeks (OR = 2.43, 95% CI = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004) … 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1% … in the placebo group
claims.applicability: 确诊慢性冠脉综合征、不耐受硝酸酯人群的 4 周心绞痛症状改善；与咖啡因相关心悸无直接关系
claims.uncertainty: 单国多中心、样本较小、随访仅 4 周、以症状评分为终点而非临床事件

claims.claim: 速效救心丸现有对照研究以心电图缺血改善与心绞痛症状评分为终点，且排除了严重心律失常患者，未见以心律失常发作或早搏负荷为终点的研究，亦未见按咖啡因摄入量分层的亚组分析。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates
claims.supportQuote: participants with a history or clinical evidence of poorly controlled or severe disease were excluded. These included … severe arrhythmias … the TCM main syndrome score is the sum of five patients' self-reported symptom scores (chest pain, chest tightness, shortness of breath, fatigue, and palpitation).
claims.applicability: 界定本品研究人群与终点，据以判断其对心律失常/咖啡因相关心悸的间接性
claims.uncertainty: 该 RCT 排除严重心律失常、以心绞痛域为终点；心悸仅为中医证候评分中一项症状条目，非心律失常终点

claims.claim: 〔推导〕咖啡因血浆半衰期约 2.5–5 小时，按一级消除经 4 个半衰期（约 10–20 小时）血药浓度降至峰值约 1/16（约 6%），与咖啡因相关心悸多为短时一过性的临床现象在时间量级上一致；故单次咖啡因后持续数小时以上的心悸不宜默认归因于咖啡因本身。
claims.method: 一级消除近似：n 个半衰期后剩余浓度 = 峰浓度 × (1/2)^n；取 n=4，得 (1/2)^4 = 1/16 ≈ 6.25%；半衰期 2.5–5 h 时 4 个半衰期为 10–20 h。
claims.assumptions: 咖啡因消除在常规剂量下近似一级动力学；忽略 CYP1A2 基因型、吸烟、妊娠与合用药物对半衰期的影响；仅作时间量级估计。
claims.sensitivity: 慢代谢者半衰期可更长（文献载 2–10 h），4 个半衰期可达 8–40 h；若取 6 个半衰期则剩余约 1.6%。该推导不能用于判定个体心悸病因，仅提示时间窗边界。
claims.applicability: 用于提示单次咖啡因相关心悸的时间可逆性边界，不构成临床诊断工具
claims.uncertainty: 半衰期为人群平均估计；不适用于中毒剂量（动力学可饱和）

claims.claim: 常规剂量的习惯性咖啡/咖啡因摄入未显示增加总体心律失常风险，其急性心血管效应主要为可逆的血压、心率与儿茶酚胺升高及少数个体的室性早搏增加；致死性心律失常限于中毒剂量（血浆 ≥15 mg/L 毒性、80–100 mg/L 致死）或已有易感底质（如遗传性通道病、能量饮料高剂量）者。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Coffee and cardiac arrhythmias: Up-date review of the literature and clinical studies
supportingSources.supportQuote: habitual consumption of coffee in moderate amounts (2–3 cups of coffee/day) does not increase the risk of arrhythmia, and might even reduce it slightly. While coffee consumption may increase the risk of premature ventricular contractions, these results are inconsistent and require further study.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: The risk of premature cardiac contractions (PAC/PVC) related to caffeine consumption among healthcare workers
supportingSources.supportQuote: the currently available data do not provide strong evidence for the association between caffeine and PAC or PVC in the general population. Most studies examining the impact of caffeine consumption on arrhythmogenesis had reported negative results.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Caffeine and Arrhythmias: A Critical Analysis of Cardiovascular Responses and Arrhythmia Susceptibility
supportingSources.supportQuote: Research on caffeine’s effects on the cardiovascular system indicates that acute consumption may lead to transient heart rate and blood pressure increases, chronic effects are unclear.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Caffeine-Related Deaths: Manner of Deaths and Categories at Risk
supportingSources.supportQuote: Serious toxicities such as seizure and cardiac arrhythmias, seen with caffeine plasma concentrations of 15 mg/L or higher … Caffeine concentrations of 80–100 mg/L are considered lethal.

claims.applicability: 健康成人常规咖啡因摄入的心血管安全性总括判断；不覆盖中毒剂量、能量饮料高剂量与已知心律失常易感者
claims.uncertainty: 跨研究综合结论：观察性证据为主，存在反向因果与混杂；室性早搏方向不一致；证据确定性中等

claims.claim: DECAF 随机试验显示，房颤电复律后继续饮用咖啡者较戒断者的房颤/房扑复发降低 39%（p=0.01），结果适用于平均每日一杯的饮用者。
claims.sourceTitle: No DECAF Coffee for Me, Please!
claims.supportQuote: The study demonstrated a 39% reduction in the primary endpoint among coffee consumers compared with abstainers (p=0.01). This effect was comparable when AF alone was analysed.
claims.applicability: 房颤电复律后患者的咖啡摄入与房颤/房扑复发；支持“戒咖啡降低心悸/房颤发作”说法缺乏直接证据的方向
claims.uncertainty: 为对该随机试验的综述性转述（非原始试验正文）；试验开放标签、戒断组依从性 69%、仅纳入持续性房颤、结果适用于每日一杯者
